components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 15px/1 var(--sans, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2f5d50); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), background-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), border-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2f5d50); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2f5d50) 86%, var(--ink, #1d1d1b)); border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5d50); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action next to the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 15px/1 var(--sans, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); background: var(--panel, #fff); padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcfc7); transition: transform 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), border-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5d50); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Command Box
components.description: One shell command in mono with a copy button. Site only.
components.html: $ ./bin/terces scan path ~/src/my-service
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2dc); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(29,29,27,0.05), 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(29,29,27,0.16)); } .ds-cmd code { flex: 1; font: 14px/1.55 var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); padding: 8px 0; } .ds-prompt { color: var(--muted, #62625d); user-select: none; } .ds-copy { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #62625d); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-copy:hover { background: var(--code-bg, #f0f0ec); color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2f5d50); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-copy svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Stored Row Panel
components.description: A hairline panel with a head and a mono definition list. It shows what the store keeps.
components.css: .ds-panel { margin: 0; background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2dc); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(29,29,27,0.05), 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(29,29,27,0.16)); overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); font-family: var(--sans, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2dc); font-size: 13px; } .ds-file { font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #62625d); } .ds-dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-dl dt, .ds-dl dd { margin: 0; padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2dc); } .ds-dl dt { color: var(--muted, #62625d); font: 13px/1.6 var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); } .ds-dl dt:last-of-type, .ds-dl dd:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-dl code { font: 13.5px var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); }

components.name: Severity Pills
components.description: Severity labels in tables and stored rows. Medium carries ink text.

components.css: .ds-sev { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12px/1.6 var(--sans, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); color: #fff; } .ds-critical { background: var(--critical, #a4161a); } .ds-high { background: var(--high, #c2410c); } .ds-medium { background: var(--medium, #b08900); color: #1d1d1b; } .ds-low { background: var(--low, #5c7080); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-sev { color: #141413; } }

components.name: Code Chip
components.description: Inline code inside prose. It stays on one line.
components.html: Read .terces.yaml from the base commit.
components.css: .ds-p { font: 16px/1.6 var(--sans, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1d1d1b); margin: 0; } .ds-code { font-family: var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); font-size: 0.875em; background: var(--code-bg, #f0f0ec); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.1em 0.35em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Format Tabs

narrative.overview:
terces shows proof, and the visual system exists to carry that proof. Every surface is a quiet paper ground with white panels on it. The panels hold real scan output: commands, diffs, stored rows, tables and terminal text. The system uses one deep green accent and four severity hues. Everything else is warm gray.

The system has two homes. The first home is the HTML report that the binary writes, in `internal/render/report.html`. The second home is the GitHub Pages site in `site/`. The site inherits the tokens of the report and adds the marketing and teaching parts. Both homes follow light and dark mode from the same custom property names. Both homes make no external requests and load no font files.

The density is that of a working tool. Text is small and exact, panels are tight, and decoration is close to zero. Depth comes from a hairline border and one soft shadow, not from color fills or large lifts.
keyCharacteristics: A warm paper ground with white hairline panels and `10px` corners.
Monospace for every artifact. System sans for prose.
One green accent for action and current state. Four severity hues for severity only.
Dark mode swaps values on the same tokens.
Real output, never a full secret. A preview or a redaction chip stands in for the secret.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ledger Green is the only hue that means "act here" or "you are here". Do not add a second brand hue.

rules.name: The Severity Is Data Rule
rules.body: The four severity hues appear only where they encode severity or a failed state. Do not use them for decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Same Tokens Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes the values of the same custom properties inside `prefers-color-scheme: dark`. Components do not carry their own dark styles. The one exception is pill text, which turns to `bg-dark` on the bright dark-mode severity fills.

rules.name: The Artifact In Mono Rule
rules.body: Set every command, path, rule ID, fingerprint, preview and output line in the mono stack. Set every sentence of explanation in the sans stack.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Tables and counts use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so the columns of numbers align.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A panel always has its `1px` Hairline border. The shadow is optional and stays soft. Do not use a shadow without the border.

dos: Do put every artifact on a Sheet panel with a `1px` Hairline border and `10px` corners.
Do use the mono stack for every command, path, rule ID, preview, fingerprint and output line.
Do show real output from the binary, made from synthetic fake tokens, and label it as synthetic.
Do show a secret as a preview such as `ghp_… (40)` or as a redaction chip.
Do add every new color as a custom property with a light value and a dark value.
Do keep text on every fill at `4.5:1` contrast or more.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` for every scripted animation and for smooth scroll.
donts: Don't render a full token-shaped string in markup, a screenshot or an example.
Don't use a severity hue for decoration, a heading or a link.
Don't add a second accent hue.
Don't load external fonts, images or scripts. Both homes run under a strict Content Security Policy.
Don't use a large or dark drop shadow. The Panel lift is the only site shadow.
Don't fill a panel with a tint to make it stand out. Use the border, the shadow and the content.
